name: queue
description: Ship work unattended between gates: one task, a whole label queue, or a bug hunt, each fix through the merge gate and the review panel to a pull request. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.

base_branch.title: Base branch
base_branch.description: The branch pull requests target and reviews diff against.

repo_slug.title: Repository
repo_slug.description: owner/name of the GitHub repository. Blank: read from the git remote.

queue_label.title: Queue label
queue_label.description: The label that marks issues ready for /queue:ship-queue.

merge_gate.title: Merge gate
merge_gate.description: A command that must pass before a pull request is merge-ready, or a label that triggers the required check. Blank: the base branch's required GitHub checks.

github_project.title: GitHub Project
github_project.description: owner/number of a GitHub Project board new issues are added to. Blank: no board.

logs_metrics.title: Logs and metrics
logs_metrics.description: How /queue:bug-hunt checks production evidence: a command or a short note. Blank: that step is skipped and the finding says so.
